mcqs.question: According to the reported milestones of Primary Amoebic Meningoencephalitis (PAM) in India, what was recorded in 2023?
mcqs.explanation: In 2023, India recorded 36 PAM cases and 9 deaths. The figures of 8 cases and 9 deaths, and 14 cases and 9 deaths, do not represent the 2023 milestone; 11 refers to the reported number of global survivors in another context.

mcqs.question: Which statement correctly describes red dwarfs in the context of the rare quadruple star system UPM J1040−3551 AabBab?
options: They are the most common stars, comprise about 70% of Milky Way stars, and are long-lived
They are failed stars that cannot sustain hydrogen fusion and can reach 70 times Jupiter’s mass
They are cold T-type brown dwarfs orbiting a pair of young red dwarfs
They are among the hottest and most luminous stars
mcqs.explanation: Red dwarfs are the most common stars, making up about 70% of the Milky Way’s stars, and they are long-lived. The second and third options describe brown dwarfs, while the fourth describes blue supergiants.
